requirements.requirement: S0–S8 shells have explicit semantics, overlap bands, update rates, and resource budgets.
Shell transitions are smooth and use hysteresis.
Shell radii adapt to movement, visibility, terrain, platform budget, and mission demand without changing canonical truth.
Narrative/causal authority wells can override geometric shell priority within bounded policy.
Shell occupancy and transition telemetry are inspectable.
No shell boundary acts as an entity existence/destruction boundary.
Shell movement has maximum expansion/contraction rates unless an explicit emergency/teleport protocol is active.
Shell boundaries are decoupled from world-region boundaries to prevent synchronization artifacts.
Per-shell update cadence, precision, and resource budgets are machine-readable and runtime-observable.
Adaptive shell control is stable under oscillating camera direction and repeated speed changes.
World shells may be anisotropic and terrain/visibility aware, but every adaptive shape remains bounded and deterministic for replay.
